اختبئوا (form VIII)
# اُخْتُبِئُوا (uḵtubiʔū) /ux.tu.bi.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# اِخْتَبِئُوا (iḵtabiʔū) /ix.ta.bi.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
